items.title: Show HN: Sip pacer that helps you drink slower
items.summary: It's a new feature I've added to my app Pour Decision. The idea is: 1. Set an interval on your phone and slip it in your pocket 2. The phone vibrates in your pocket on every interval 3. Condition yourself to have sips when you feel the vibration Benefits: - You end up drinking way less in a night than you normally would - You don't feel like you're moderating cus you're never without a drink - It's discreet so people you're drinking with won't know you're doing this This is sort of like a HIIT-timer, but to preserve battery I took another approach. It works by pre-scheduling on-device notifications when you start the timer. iOS allows apps to schedule up to 64 notifications. If you were to set say 5-minute intervals, that covers the next 320 minutes - more than 5 hours. The phone uses no battery in between intervals, and only wakes up the device once every 5 minutes, so battery drain is negligible.
